extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / users attempting to create a new article (new or unautoconfirmed editors)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural requirements for creating a new Wikipedia article (here: a page titled 'Larry David specials'), including account prerequisites, search/redirect checks, and troubleshooting visibility or deletion. Useful for editors preparing to create or request a new page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles / alternative titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for 'Larry David specials' in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Perform a site search before creating a new article to avoid duplication and to find possible existing coverage under a different title.

rubrics_metrics.name: Look for pages that link to this title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Checking 'what links here' can reveal where the topic is already discussed and whether a redirect or integration is more appropriate than a new page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recently created page visibility delay
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wait a few minutes or try the purge function to refresh; do not recreate the page immediately if it may simply be a propagation delay.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case sensitivity and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization variants and set up redirects where appropriate to ensure users find the article regardless of minor title differences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check deletion log if page was removed
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the deletion log to learn the reason for removal and to understand what changes would be needed for a successful re-creation or request.
